Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old MANUEL, beaming with pride. He is presented with a certificate and a trophy, and the crowd erupts in applause.

**MANUEL**
(overcome with emotion)
This Is The Most Incredible Honor I Could Ever Ask For!

The camera zooms in on Manuel's face as he holds up the trophy, a wide smile spreading across his weathered features.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Manuel lies in bed, the trophy still clutched in his hand. He gazes up at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes. Suddenly, his expression changes, and he begins to speak to himself in a hushed tone.

**MANUEL**
(whispering)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It In My Youth...

As he speaks, his eyes glaze over, and his body begins to shake. He starts to pace back and forth across the room, his mind racing with thoughts and theories.

**MANUEL**
(mumbling to himself)
If I'm The Oldest Human To Ever Live, Then That Means I Must Be The Only One Who Has Survived Every Possible Branch Of Reality...

His words become more frantic, and his movements more agitated. He starts to laugh maniacally, his eyes rolling back in his head.

**MANUEL**
(screaming)
I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO HAS LIVED FOREVER! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO HAS SEEN EVERY POSSIBLE FUTURE!

The camera zooms out as Manuel's body begins to contort and twist, his limbs elongating and merging with the furniture. His face stretches into a grotesque grimace, and his eyes bulge out of their sockets.

**CUT TO:**

**BLACKNESS**

The screen fades to black as Manuel's mind shatters, consumed by the weight of his own immortality.

**FADE OUT.**
